inertia_frame: At center of mass, aligned with assembly world axes
approximations: uniform_infill scales body density uniformly; walls, solid layers, infill pattern, and print orientation are not modeled.
mass_override preserves the CAD body center of mass and scales its inertia uniformly.
printed estimates a solid shell around an affine-contracted CAD core; complex shapes, unequal top/bottom layers, and print toolpaths are approximate. Body COM stays at CAD COM.
Collision boxes do not influence mass properties.
